verdict.rationale: Vanta's TPRM product says it automatically discovers vendors, runs and speeds up assessments, and monitors third-party risk (vanta-docs-13). It also pulls findings from vendor SOC 2 reports, DPAs, and questionnaires (vanta-docs-14), which covers inventory and security-posture review in place of a spreadsheet. Review cadence is only implied by automated reminders and recurring assessment workflows on the general risk page (vanta-docs-22). Missing for 10: explicit evidence of tracking each vendor's data access or data classification, vendor-specific review-cadence scheduling, in-depth TPRM documentation beyond marketing pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
